name: GitHub intelligence
desc: Repository memory, dreaming and code search that agents can draw on.
desc_zh: Agent 可以调用的仓库记忆、 dreaming 和代码搜索。
solves: Every session starts from zero and rediscovers your conventions. Memory carries preferences between sessions, dreaming keeps them current, and code search reaches past your checkout.
solves_zh: 每个会话都从零开始，把你们的约定重新发现一遍。Memory 在会话之间携带偏好，dreaming 让它们保持最新，代码搜索则能超出你本地检出范围。
best_for: The agent keeps asking why an edge case matters, and you keep explaining it.
best_for_zh: Agent 反复问某个边界情况为什么重要，而你也反复解释。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — GitHub Changelog, https://github.blog/changelog/2026-10-28-github-intelligen）。 An umbrella for three capabilities: GitHub Copilot Memory (generally available on paid plans), Dreaming, and code search beyond the local checkout. Availability and settings vary per capability. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：给编程智能体提供记忆与代码上下文的能力，归入编程智能体，而不是辅助工具。 首次公开日期来源：https://github.blog/changelog/2026-10-28-github-intelligence-puts-your-code-context-and-history-to-work/
